title: Agenda
intro: The steps of each session, in order. The wrap-up always closes the meeting.

blockHints.intro: Welcome, announcements and the icebreaker, before the first turn
blockHints.round: Each person in turn, timed, with their check-in on screen
blockHints.projects: Project by project, its people speaking together
blockHints.topics: The open topics the team brought and voted for
blockHints.timebox: A topic of its own, with its own duration
blockHints.retro: Anonymous notes in columns, grouped, voted, then discussed
blockHints.poker: The team estimates items with hidden cards
blockHints.slide: A screen of its own: free text, the team's irritants, or a review of the open actions

turnOn: Turn the module on in “Modules” to add this block.
locked: A session is running: the agenda can change once it is over.
noProjects: choose the projects the meeting follows in “Projects”.
slideBodyHint: Markdown: context, figures, a reminder of the rules…
